_about: Lab-only details for the ACNL project pages, keyed by the start of each award's title as it appears in build_site.py. award: the grant numbers papers cite in their acknowledgements (matched from Crossref funding records; the ones marked inferred are matched by sponsor program and year and should be confirmed). threads: research threads of the lab record used for related work. figure: an image key from images.json. lessons: the team's own lessons learned, one sentence each; empty until the team writes them.

SUMMIT.figcap: SUMMIT's three-site architecture: the UMass Lowell main site with its real-time simulators and control, network, and instrumentation equipment; a wide-area software-defined network; and the federation sites at NYU Tandon and West Virginia University.

Flexible Spectrum Allocation.figcap: FUSION, built on this award: reinforcement learning over a software-defined optical mesh.
Flexible Spectrum Allocation.figcap2: AI services over a software-defined, multi-layer optical network.

Resilient Smart Grids.figcap: NATIG co-simulation of a distribution grid and its wireless network, used in the lab's grid security work.
